infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc:
The pressure of the looming Catastrophe weighs upon the psyche of the Doctor's team, though a small back-and-forth with Nearl helps ease up the anxiety slightly.
The long journey home continues.

The Doctor's team passes by a clinic called Azazel.
Gazing upon this now empty complex, recollections of the past and the outlook of a desolate future leads many to reflect upon the conditions of the Infected.

From the point of view of an instructor, Dobermann has greater expectations for Amiya. However, she has also acknowledged the Doctor's commanding abilities.
Time is running out, and the Doctor decides to push for a frontal breakthrough.
With no time for hesitation, everyone continues to sprint forward.

The rescue squad comes to a clearing, where they see Reunion brutalizing civilians. Amiya wants to rescue them, but is stopped by Ace.
There are more important things to do, and they must move on.

A woman stands atop a tall building and takes in the herculean efforts of the Doctor and the rescue squad.
Then, as if responding to her poetic words, the sky sank into a pool of blood.

The Doctor makes a valiant effort to rescue a medic operator, and is put in harm's way in the process. Fortunately, Nearl comes to the rescue once more.
Even with an ominous storm about to fall, Reunion continues to attack.

Reunion members pour out from every nook and cranny, trapping the Doctor and the rescue squad in the city plaza.
It is at that time that Talulah, the tyrant of Reunion, approaches them.

Confronted with Talulah's oppressive power, Amiya chooses to ■ ■ ■ ■
But her power alone is not enough. Just when she is unable to hold on any longer, Ace steps out in front of her–

While Dobermann and Nearl are choked with grief, Amiya remains silent in the Doctor's arms.
They all knew... that Ace would never return home.

W pays a visit to the Doctor and the rescue party, seeing that the evacuation is about to be completed.
Amiya stands resolute when mocked by W's questions and responds with her own answer.

After one battle, W suddenly lets the party go free, with Talulah actually ordering her to not give chase.
Overcome with doubt, sorrow, and exhaustion, everyone finally sets foot on the road back home.
